regions.merged_text: God bless you and yours. Many thanks for favor just noted. Thank the Dear Lord that there is at least "A rift in the clouds" now and then. After all that is what "life" on earth is like-ups and downs, rain and sunshine . . .. "Great Life if one don't weaken" Hence: "Poor wanderers of a stormy day: from wave to wave we re driven. Moore. And fancy's flash and reason's ray serve but to light the troubled way. There's nothing calm but Heaven." Courage therefore, with the souls eye fixed-on the goal of Eternity, it behoves us to battle on.
